final: WITH pp AS (SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, AVG(l.ALB - l.TP) AS m1, AVG(l.APTT - l.PT) AS m2 FROM Laboratory l JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX), sx AS (SELECT SEX, AVG(m1) AS a1, AVG(m2) AS a2 FROM pp GROUP BY SEX), g AS (SELECT AVG(a2) AS avg2 FROM sx WHERE a2 IS NOT NULL), k AS (SELECT sx.SEX, sx.a1, sx.a2, sx.a2 - g.avg2 AS d FROM sx JOIN g ON g.avg2 IS NOT NULL WHERE sx.a2 > g.avg2) SELECT AVG(a1), AVG(a2), AVG(d) FROM k
